newsitem.title: LEBANON: Four Israeli soldiers wounded in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Four Israeli soldiers wounded in south Lebanon.

text.p: Four Israeli soldiers were wounded, three of them seriously, when a roadside bomb exploded near their patrol in south Lebanon overnight, pro-Israeli militia sources said on Thursday.
The South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said the blast occured in the Shoumariyyeh area in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack.
On Wednesday, Israeli planes rocketed suspected Moslem Hizbollah guerrilla targets in Iqlim al-Toufah ridge north of the Israeli-held zone but no one was hurt.

The pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong allied SLA militia holding the south Lebanon zone set up by Israel in 1985 to protect its northern border area from guerrilla raids.
